newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee buyers sidelined, prices ease.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee buyers sidelined, prices ease.

text.p: Green coffee demand has been muted amid volatile futures in the trading days around the four-day March 28-31 Easter holidays, traders said on Friday.
Arabica prices in the Bremen coffee market were $1-20 down on the last fortnight per 50 kg fob.
Brazils dropped by just $1 to $193 while Central Americans were offered $10-12 cheaper, attracting outright purchases.
Colombian business was routine while nearby African arabica offers were scarce.
Robustas maintained a favourable discount but buyers were not forthcoming.
